name: jbtest
expr: [h1, p1, J1, c1] = jbtest(xn); [h2, p2, J2, c2] = jbtest(xn, 0.01); JB_b = jbtest(xb);
comment: Sig: [h, p, JB, cv] = jbtest(x[, alpha[, mctol]]). For small n (<2000), Monte-Carlo simulation under H₀ for tabulated-style p-value (matches MATLAB R2025b). For large n, χ²(2) asymptotic. p capped at 0.5. Critical values are MC-estimated for small n so they vary slightly between runs (numkit uses fixed seed for reproducibility). Spec excludes cv from fingerprint (different MC seeds → different cv); JB stat itself is deterministic and bit-identical.
